text: dsh-opencli 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的登录态浏览器自动化插件，通过 OpenCLI daemon 和 BrowserBridge 扩展把站点适配器及通用网页操作接入 DSH 工具，并提供浏览器代理面板。它支持结构化站点命令、多站并行采集、浏览器页面操作、定时任务与变化通知，也可读取和点击网页画布。适合需要使用自己浏览器登录会话查询网页、周期采集内容或处理适配器未覆盖页面的用户。使用前需安装 OpenCLI CLI、daemon 和浏览器扩展，并登录目标站点。

dsh-opencli connects DSH to your logged-in browser through OpenCLI and BrowserBridge. It offers site commands, page actions, scheduled collection, notifications, and canvas tools. Requires OpenCLI, its daemon, and the browser extension.
想让 DSH 用我已经登录的浏览器查询网站内容
能不能用一句站点命令获取结构化网页结果？

Use my signed-in browser to run website commands from DSH
Schedule recurring website collection and notify me when results change
让 DSH 帮我操作需要登录的网站页面
Can DSH collect structured results from several sites at once?
dsh-opencli 的功能「站点结构化命令」：通过 site 工具调用 OpenCLI 适配器，以站点和命令获取结构化结果；可并行运行多站点命令。。
dsh-opencli 的功能「登录态网页操作」：通过 opencli_open、opencli_state、opencli_click 等工具操作真实浏览器中的页面，读取状态并执行交互。。
dsh-opencli 的功能「定时采集与通知」：创建持久化 cron 采集任务，可配置失败重试和关键词监控；监控命中或内容变化后可通过通知通道推送。。
dsh-opencli 的功能「画布读取与点击」：canvas_discover 定位网页画布，canvas_read 读取位图，canvas_click 按坐标交互。。
dsh-opencli 的 opencli_* 浏览器工具依赖本机 OpenCLI daemon 与 BrowserBridge 扩展；未检测到扩展时，浏览器操作无法使用。

**dsh 插件 · 登录态驱动的浏览器数据引擎。** 经 [OpenCLI](https://github.com/jackwener/OpenCLI) daemon + BrowserBridge 扩展驱动你日常使用的真实浏览器(Chrome/Edge),提供 170 站点一步式结构化命令、登录态网页原语、定时采集、真实性判定、推送通知与带出处的运行回放。dsh 内置 web 工具面向匿名检索;本插件补上账号视角的一半——所有数据来自你已登录的会话,所有写操作先经人工审批。

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · 工作原理：```
dsh agent ─┬─ 工具调用(site / opencli_* / canvas_*)──┐
dsh 面板 ──┼─ 面板 RPC(定时/通知/画布/审计)─────────┤
任意会话 ──┴─ dsh-opencli-ctl(收件箱意图)────────┤
                                                    ▼

所有执行路径汇聚到同一个插件服务:写操作经审批门(fail-closed),采集结果经真实性判定(exit 0 不等于有效数据),每次运行落快照与轨迹供回放。

> npm 包为 **@cold777/dsh-opencli**——无作用域的 `dsh-opencli` 名已被一个无关的低层工具占用,搜索时请注意区分:本插件是 170+ 站点结构化命令 + 定时采集告警 + 审批门的完整产品;安装命令一律以本 README 为准。

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · 与其他 browser 插件的选型：dsh 生态里的浏览器自动化插件大体两条技术路线,按场景选,不冲突:

- **CDP attach 类**(连已开浏览器的调试端口):适合脚本化的页面操控,轻、快;但没有站点语义层,也没有面向无人值守的产品层。
- **本插件(daemon + BrowserBridge 扩展)**:走你日常浏览器的登录态,价值在语义层之上的产品闭环——170+ 站点一步式命令、写操作审批门、采集真实性判定、定时采集 + 变化告警 + 多渠道推送、快照 diff、带出处报告与运行回放。适合"让 agent/定时任务持续用你的账号办事"的场景。

两者也可共存:调试端口的操控类插件管页面操作,本插件管数据产品与审批链。

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · Scheduled Collection → Push：Persistent cron tasks run real collection through your logged-in browser: failures retry ×3 automatically, successes land as structured snapshots (50 kept). Watch keywords or content changes (added/removed/moved) push to Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/Telegram with a diff summary against the previous run.

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · Execution Authenticity：`exit 0` does not mean valid data. Two-layer verification (deterministic rules + sub-second decision model) flags empty results, anti-bot walls, and login pages as "suspected silent failure" — unattended tasks retry on failure. Every snapshot traces back to the command and time that produced it.

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · Structured Site Commands：170 sites / 1,200+ commands in a precompiled catalog, distilled into systemPrompt so agents pick the right command on the first try — no trial and error. Each site ships a knowledge card (known pitfalls + failure-signature recovery table). Multi-site parallel collection via `site_batch`.

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · Web Primitives & Canvas Bitmaps：For pages without adapters: logged-in primitives (open/click/fill/extract/screenshot and more); the eval family goes over a direct daemon transport for millisecond round trips. Canvas bitmap surfaces (charts/games/whiteboards) get a three-tool set: discover, read (bitmap auto-archived into the canvas view), click (write-gated).

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · Run Replay：Every browser and scheduled execution lands as JSONL traces; the canvas view aggregates traces, evidence, and snapshots into a pannable, zoomable card flow — click a card to replay each step (command/screenshot/duration). Failed steps include output excerpts: no guessing why the last run failed.

@cold777/dsh-opencli README · Write Approval Gate：Posting, deleting, and other write commands pop an approval prompt by default; execution requires explicit allow, with before/after screenshots archived as evidence. Unclear permission is treated as write (fail-closed). attack table of 22 rows (incl. 5 read-only controls) + 3 independent side-channels, each covered by a dedicated regression test, plus 200 reproducible fuzz iterations, invariant: **every allow ⟹ read-only intent** (see [Security Invariants](#security-invariants)).
